description: Angular component for selecting and managing widget bundles, including fetching bundles, filtering, selection, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: WidgetsBundleSelectComponent
classes.description: Angular component for selecting widget bundles with filtering, dialog, and value accessor functionalities.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback function for touch events.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, fetches widget bundles, and sets up filtering based on auth state.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, especially selectBundleAlias.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a value to the component.

methods.name: widgetsBundleChanged
methods.description: Triggers view update when widget bundle selection changes.

methods.name: isSystem
methods.description: Checks if a widget bundle is a system bundle based on tenantId.

methods.name: selectWidgetsBundleByAlias
methods.description: Selects a widget bundle by its alias.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Propagates the current widget bundle value.

methods.name: getWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Fetches widget bundles based on scope and exclusions.

methods.name: compareById
methods.description: Compares two widget bundles by their IDs.

methods.name: openWidgetsBundleDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog to create a new widget bundle and updates the list upon save.
